description: Implementation of a priority task queue with multiple internal queue types and consumer management, supporting various concurrency policies.

classes.name: detail::any_task_consumer
classes.description: Abstract base class for task consumers with try_pop and try_pop_bulk methods.

classes.name: detail::any_task_queue
classes.description: Abstract base class for task queues with capacity, policy, and various push/pop methods.

classes.name: any_task_queue_impl
classes.description: Template class implementing any_task_queue for specific concurrency policies.

classes.name: detail::priority_task_queue
classes.description: Main class managing multiple prioritized queues with push, pop, and consumer creation functionalities.

classes.name: detail::priority_task_queue::consumer_type
classes.description: Handles consumers for each internal queue, supporting try_pop and bulk operations.

methods.name: make_any_task_queue
methods.description: Factory function to create a task queue based on provided concurrency policy parameters.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::request_stop
methods.description: Requests all internal queues and the policy to stop processing.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes a task into the queue at a specified priority with blocking behavior.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push a task into the queue at a specified priority.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop a task from the highest priority queues.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to bulk pop tasks from all priority queues.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::pop_blocking
methods.description: Blocking pop of a task with optional wait time.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::size
methods.description: Returns total size of all internal queues.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::queue_capacity
methods.description: Returns capacity of a specific priority queue.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::create_consumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer object for internal queues.
